name: hayvenhurst
description: Hayvenhurst: a persistent, trace-augmented code graph for AI coding agents. Installs the hayvenhurst Agent Skill and slash commands that steer Claude Code toward the local hayven CLI instead of grep. Also part of the Sothis suite marketplace (hayvenhurst@sothis).

plugins.name: hayvenhurst
plugins.description: Reach for `hayven` over grep. Ships the Hayvenhurst Agent Skill so Claude Code queries a persistent, trace-augmented code graph of your repo (callers/callees, dependencies, runtime traces) through the local Hayvenhurst daemon instead of grepping or reading large files.
